crossRefs.note: One who has a perverse heart doesn’t find prosperity, and one who has a deceitful tongue falls into trouble.

crossRefs.note: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.

crossRefs.note: Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.
Yahweh has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands.
Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.
Misfortune pursues sinners, but prosperity rewards the righteous.
Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them; for the deeds of his hands will be paid back to him.

translations.web: An evil speaker won’t be established in the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
translations.bsb: May no slanderer be established in the land; may calamity hunt down the man of violence.
